metric_definitions.valid_positions: Number of nonpadding diagnostic training positions scored.
metric_definitions.neural_margin: Mean positive-minus-negative neural logit on diagnostic training positions; in-sample.
metric_definitions.fused_margin: Mean positive-minus-negative combined logit using the full training-only transition table; in-sample, not an unbiased generalization estimate.
metric_definitions.residual_margin: Mean gated residual positive-minus-negative contribution on the same diagnostic positions; in-sample.
metric_definitions.gate: Sigmoid of the learned scalar residual gate, bounded between zero and one.
